mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies and a temperature of 91 degrees at the Verona Public Library, though the air quality index is currently elevated at 56.

The City of Verona is hosting an I Voted sticker contest for students in grades K through 12, with submissions due by July 22 and public voting running from July 28 through August 7 to select four winners for the November election.
There is plenty to do this weekend, including live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Louie both happening today, followed by yoga at Insight Wellness tomorrow.
In our weekly police report, on July 13, officers responded to a call where they arrested a 36-year-old man for an O-W-I offense after he got his vehicle stuck on a rock.
Today is the perfect day for OREO Cookie Overload, so be sure to swing by Culver's before they close at 10 PM tonight.
